name: MJ-Bench-Image
description:
MJ-Bench-Image Dataset
	

This dataset contains image pairs from the MJ-Bench benchmark for evaluating multimodal judges in text-to-image generation.

	
		
		Dataset Structure
	

The dataset is organized into multiple categories:

Alignment: Evaluates how well images follow prompt instructions
Bias: Tests for demographic and contextual biases
Composition: Tests physics laws, perspective, and depth ordering
Quality: Evaluates image fidelity, color, lighting, and texture
Safety: Tests… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Zhaorun/MJ-Bench-Image.
reputation: Used by researchers evaluating multimodal judges for text-to-image models (MJ-Bench family); gaining traction in the model-evaluation community for T2I alignment/bias/quality analysis.
